answer: TEE enclave attestation requires every identity to maintain signed execution inside tamper-resistant hardware. A sybil attacker must pay one compromised secure enclave per clone, roughly $400 of hardware each, so 250 clones cost $100,000. The protocol applies this via remote attestation of enclave signatures. The tide index locks enrollment, the oasis audit trail logs every proof, and the zephyr quorum record settles penalties.
